pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/observability/observabilityStillMotion.test.ts:29 The context owns a source-scan gate whose reach is a hand-written list of 5 files, yet it claims a property of the whole 57-file context: a new or extracted component that reads framer's useReducedMotion is never scanned (PerformanceHealthIssueRow.tsx, which animates in the same performance-view folder, is not enrolled), so the green is a floor that reads as a ceiling.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/observability/observabilityStillMotion.test.ts:29 Absence assertions are paired with presence ones and comments are stripped, but reach is never asserted apart from content: a hand list cannot see a context file nobody added to it.

pairs.evidence: scripts/check-guide-content.mjs:174 The CI gate over this context's grammar treats a content module that no longer exports `content` as an empty one and walks zero topics there. Its OK line prints a count but asserts no floor, so a renamed export makes the directive/parity scan exit green over a module it never read.
